_note: Passages a card shows for a daf or a commentary, each read with the entry's sense of the words the matching marked in it (2026-10-07). 'not' lists the words, bare, that are another word sharing the letters (רעה, evil, for rei'a, a friend), which the build leaves unmarked; 'kept' the words read and found to be the entry's. 'seg' is the passage's fingerprint, so a verdict lapses if Sefaria's text changes. tools/check_excerpts.py lists what is left to judge.
